product.name: Branching
product.description: A product that manages control flow by splitting logic into multiple branches using natural language scripts.

product.name: Conditionals & Looping
product.description: A feature enabling the implementation of conditional statements and loops in natural language scripts.

product.name: Web Navigation
product.description: A tool for automating interactions with web pages using a headless browser.

product.name: Custom Functions
product.description: A feature that generates custom JavaScript functions for variable and array manipulations.

product.name: Repeating Workflows
product.description: A scheduling feature that runs scripts at specified intervals using CRON expressions generated from natural language.

product.name: Dashboards & UI
product.description: A tool to create interactive user interface dashboards with components like tables, forms, and buttons.
